What each recording's page on Freesound said when it was read and saved.

The saved pages themselves are not in this repository: Freesound's pages
carry a map token of Freesound's own, and GitHub does not accept a commit
that holds it. They are kept with the owner's working files. The SHA-256
of each saved page is given here so that copy can be checked.

  Title:        Dripping.wav
  Uploaded by:  digifishmusic
  Uploaded on:  January 16th, 2008
  License:      Attribution 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
  File:         Type Wave (.wav); Duration 0:11.526; File size 1.9 MB; Sample rate 44.1 kHz; Bit depth 16 bit; Channels Stereo
  Description:  Sound of a dripping tap as recorded about 15 cm below the surface of the water directly under the impact point. Hydrophones were resting in the bottom of a metal sink.
